items.name: Secret Vault
items.summary: First, the Underground House must be selected. Enter the house and go underground. Go behind the television. An orange/yellow button will be visible. Click it. The vault door will open, allowing access to the vault interior. This room is commonly used for roleplay.

items.name: The Grave
items.summary: Go to the Brookhaven Cemetery. Stand in front of the third grave from the left. Jump inside the grave. An Easter egg is revealed. Fun Fact: The coffin is labeled as property of the Agency.

items.name: Second Floor of Hospital
items.summary: Enter the hospital through the main entrance. Take a ladder from the inventory. A broken wall is located above the desk. Place the ladder beneath it. Climb the ladder and enter the broken wall to access the secret room. Go to the emergency room roof next to the hospital. Climb onto the roof (a ladder may be required). Walk to the opposite side of the roof. Enter through the broken window. A hidden room is discovered.

items.name: Secret Room in the X-Ray Room (Hospital)
items.summary: Enter the hospital. Go into the X-ray room. Jump behind the skeleton image. Walk through the wall to access a hidden room. From this room, an additional secret can be accessed: Look at the desk. Look underneath the desk to find a blue button. Press the blue button. To exit, look at the small wooden stool and press the blue button to teleport out.

items.name: Buggstra Was Here
items.summary: Go to the Mall. Enter Rosie’s Gym on the upper floor. This area contains an angel version of Rosie the Cat from O1G (OnlyOneGam3r). Rosie passed away, and this reference was added by Wolfpaq in her honor. (Edit made by O1S) Look at the wall near the desk to find the Easter egg.

items.name: Secret Room (House Shown Below)
items.summary: Enter the house. Go downstairs near the arcade machines. Near a pillar next to the bookshelves, a small platform/button can be found. Clicking it opens a ramp leading downward. A hidden room is revealed. Another secret exists in this house (a guide is available on O1G’s channel). Obtain a computer. Sit in all available chairs. Go behind the pillar in the back-left or back-right. Click the white button at the top. Go to the front-left or front-right wall. The wall opens, revealing another room. Inside this room, the Happy Burger meal shows text on the fries reading "Burger Barn".

items.summary: Go to the Yacht at Lake Madison. Go to the lower level of the ship. Enter the bathroom. Walk into the shower and pass through the wall. A hidden room containing weapons is found.

items.name: Below the Fountain
items.summary: Go to the spawn area. Enter the Downtown subway. Look at the wall inside the subway. Click the city icon. Walk into the right side of the wall. Continue walking until reaching an area below the fountain. To exit, walk back into the wall and press the green button.

items.name: Accessory Noise
items.summary: Some accessories produce sounds when worn: Brighteyes' Witches Brew Hat – Produces a witch laughing sound. Brighteyes' Bloxy Cola Hat – Produces Bloxy Cola opening, slurping, and burping sounds. Telamon's Chicken Suit – Produces chicken sounds. Transient Harmonica – Produces harmonica sounds.

items.name: Agency Bunker
items.summary: To locate the Agency Bunker, go to the right side of the Gas Station. A hidden entrance will open, leading inside.

items.name: Power Plant
items.summary: Main page: Power Plant The Power Plant is a major landmark in Brookhaven, introduced in the Power Plant Update (August–September 2025). It is a nuclear-style facility featuring turbines, cooling towers, control rooms, and interactive props. Fully explorable interior with multiple rooms and interactive elements. Classified as a Landmark plot, allowing visitors but restricting actions such as banning. Includes thematic tools such as a Geiger counter. Agency Room A hidden Agency Room exists beneath the Power Plant. Accessible via the Reactor Room using manholes and corridors. Requires a Blue Key Card located in Cell #2 of the Police Station. Contains Agency-related equipment and computers. Meltdown Event and Green Crystal A meltdown can be triggered using C4, waste room levers, and cooling valve shutdowns. Sirens and warning lights activate during the meltdown. Interacting with the reactor core grants a Green Crystal, which currently has no known use. Agency symbols suggest a larger hidden storyline. Community maps hint at connections to other secret locations. Explorations have revealed ladders, transparent walls, and hidden doors. Located near the Brookhaven Airport. Larger and more detailed than the former Brookhaven Electric building. For lore-related content, visit: solve-bh-mystery
